governance_mode.description: Checkpoint gatekeeper governance level: strict-4-gate (C0, C1, C2, C3), streamlined-2-gate (C1, C3), or autonomous-batch

max_repair_attempts.description: Maximum Reflexion repair iterations between @Engineer and @Auditor before human checkpoint escalation

toolchain.description: Python verification test discovery and static validation configuration

scratch_retention.description: Lifecycle of .pipeline_scratch/ transient staging: consume-once cleans rollback/OCR staging immediately; archive-trace additionally persists per-agent reasoning traces (*_trace.md) into specs/<slug>/scratch_traces/

approved_research_domains.description: Additional workspace-approved domains auto-authorized for web_fetch research alongside approved_sources.json

allow_web_research.description: When false, disables web_fetch so @Researcher extracts equations, constraints, and target_interface strictly from the user prompt, SOURCE_OCR.md, and research/ files (closed-book / benchmark mode)

enable_local_spec_critic.description: Local semantic specification screening mode after manifest.json and mapping.json: 'system1_s1_s2' (default, <1 s boundary pplx-decider-flash screen with automatic 'off' fallback), 'off' (AST-1..4 + Stage 4 Cleanroom @Auditor only), 's2_only', or 's1_and_s2' (boolean true maps to 's1_and_s2', false maps to 'off')

decision_model.description: Boundary-only System-1 decision model (/v1/systemone, keep_alive=0 under OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1) for semantic spec screening, Stage 4 rewind triage override, and Method L3 edit line-scope localization

enable_post_archive_embed.description: When true, Stage 5 archival triggers templates/extensions/post_archive_embed.py (or post_archive_embed.py) out-of-band to index archived artifacts via Ollama /api/embed

upstream_seals.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to upstream PROVENANCE.json cryptographic seal files (e.g. specs/<upstream_slug>/PROVENANCE.json) that @Facet and hypervisor-guard must verify before launching @Orchestrator
